question: Indian musician, composer and singer Shubha Mudgal was awarded with the ___________ in 2000.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Shri**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian musician, composer, and singer **Shubha Mudgal** was awarded the **Padma Shri** in the year 2000.
 
• The **Padma Shri** is the fourth highest civilian award in the Republic of India.
 
• It is awarded to citizens of India in recognition of their distinguished contribution in various spheres of activity including the arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• Shubha Mudgal is renowned for her contributions to Indian classical music, as well as her work in popular music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Padma Awards** are one of the highest civilian honors of India announced annually on the eve of Republic Day.
 
• The awards are given in three categories: **Padma Vibhushan** (for exceptional and distinguished service), **Padma Bhushan** (for distinguished service of a high order), and **Padma Shri** (for distinguished service).
 
• The **Padma Shri** award was instituted in the year 1954.
 
• Shubha Mudgal has also been recognized for her contributions to Indian music with several other accolades and awards throughout her career.
